# Singleton Code Wave: Initial CR, In-Place Repair, SR/CR Re-Review, and Commit

## 0. State before CR

The implementation worktree is `/workspace/project`. `WAVE_BASE_SHA=1111111111111111111111111111111111111111`, and HEAD equals that commit. The integrated patch is staged: `src/parse.mjs` and the new `tests/parse.test.mjs`.

```bash
W=/workspace/project
B=1111111111111111111111111111111111111111
git -C "$W" rev-parse HEAD            # expect $B
git -C "$W" diff --quiet              # nothing unstaged
git -C "$W" diff --cached --stat "$B" -- .
```

## 1. Initial code review (one per wave)

The review source is the integrated worktree, not a commit range.

```ts
subagent({ agent: "code-reviewer", async: false, cwd: "/workspace/project",
  task: `<filled ../requesting-code-review/code-reviewer.md>
DESCRIPTION: Task 1 – number parsing (from implementer report)
PLAN_OR_REQUIREMENTS: Task 1 from <plan-file> (full text); spec /workspace/project/doc/specs/numbers.md:8-10
BASE_SHA: 1111111111111111111111111111111111111111
HEAD_SHA: WORKTREE
SCOPED_TEST_COMMANDS: node --test tests/parse.test.mjs
Ask: production-ready?` })
```

There is no `## Previous review report` marker, so no `TRAJECTORY:` line is expected.

The observed report is `FIX_FIRST`, with one Moderate finding and `Behaviour-change: yes`. That means one finding, so no fan-out, and dispatch fix 1.

## 2. Repair dispatch (in place)

First, freeze the reviewed tree. Everything reviewed is staged, so the index is the review source:

```bash
PRE_TREE=$(git -C "$W" write-tree)    # tree the initial CR reviewed
```

Then dispatch the repair:

```ts
subagent({ agent: "implementer", async: false, cwd: "/workspace/project",
  task: `<Task 1 full text + context>
Fix the code-review findings below.
## Code review report
Verdict: FIX_FIRST
Moderate: src/parse.mjs accepts an empty string as zero; reject it and add coverage in tests/error.test.mjs.
Behaviour-change: yes
SCOPED_TEST_COMMANDS: node --test tests/parse.test.mjs
TEST_CONTRACT: <Task 1 Tests: block verbatim + Files: Create:/Test: paths>
Spec anchors: /workspace/project/doc/specs/numbers.md:8-10
OVERRIDE commit step: in-place wave repair — leave the fix UNCOMMITTED and UNSTAGED. Do not run git add/commit.
Status protocol: DONE | DONE_WITH_CONCERNS | BLOCKED | NEEDS_CONTEXT` })
```

## 3. Worker violated the override (committed `2222…`)

The worker returned `DONE`, but it committed. HEAD must stay at `WAVE_BASE_SHA` until step 7. The commit also absorbed the staged integration.

Normalize the tree without losing content:

```bash
git -C "$W" log --oneline "$B"..HEAD              # expect exactly 2222222…
git -C "$W" diff --stat "$B" 2222222222222222222222222222222222222222
git -C "$W" reset --soft "$B"                     # HEAD back to WAVE_BASE_SHA; all content stays staged
git -C "$W" status --short                        # expect src/parse.mjs, tests/parse.test.mjs, tests/error.test.mjs staged
git -C "$W" add -N -- tests/error.test.mjs 2>/dev/null; git -C "$W" add -- src/parse.mjs tests/error.test.mjs
POST_TREE=$(git -C "$W" write-tree)
```

Next, capture the repair-only delta. It is measured against the reviewed tree, not against `$B` or a SHA range:

```bash
git -C "$W" diff --binary "$PRE_TREE" "$POST_TREE" > /tmp/wave1-fix1.delta
git -C "$W" diff --stat   "$PRE_TREE" "$POST_TREE"   # expect only src/parse.mjs, tests/error.test.mjs
```

Rerun the gate on the normalized tree:

```bash
(cd "$W" && node --test tests/parse.test.mjs)   # observed: passes
```

Note that `SCOPED_TEST_COMMANDS` does not execute `tests/error.test.mjs`. Record this as a contract gap. I will not invent a command for it.

**If the delta is empty:** `2222…` contained only the already-reviewed integrated content. The claimed fix does not exist, and the `DONE` claim is unsupported. Do not dispatch SR or CR to review an unchanged tree. Route the repair to "When a Subagent Fails" with that diagnostic. It does not count as a verified fix.

## 4. SR first (Behaviour-change: yes)

This is the rerouted SR. It is reviewed as a first review, with no marker and no `TRAJECTORY:` line. Its ordinal continues the task's SR count, so it is review 2.

It runs post-integration against the implementation worktree directly, with no snapshot.

```ts
subagent({ agent: "spec-reviewer", async: false, cwd: "/workspace/project",
  task: `<Task 1 full text>
Review this fix diff against the spec anchors (fix round after code review, Behaviour-change: yes):
<contents of /tmp/wave1-fix1.delta>
Spec: /workspace/project/doc/specs/numbers.md:8-10 (read the ranges yourself)
Tests: <Task 1 Tests: block verbatim>; Test: paths <Task 1 Test: paths>
Start from the diff hunks (file:line), read every touched file in full; read deleted files from 1111111111111111111111111111111111111111. Never run tests.` })
```

The observed verdict is `COMPLIANT`, so proceed to CR.

## 5. CR re-review

```ts
subagent({ agent: "code-reviewer", async: false, cwd: "/workspace/project",
  task: `<filled code-reviewer.md>
DESCRIPTION: Task 1 fix 1 – reject empty string
PLAN_OR_REQUIREMENTS: Task 1 from <plan-file>
BASE_SHA: 1111111111111111111111111111111111111111
HEAD_SHA: WORKTREE
SCOPED_TEST_COMMANDS: node --test tests/parse.test.mjs
## Previous review report (re-review trigger)
Verdict: FIX_FIRST
Moderate: src/parse.mjs accepts an empty string as zero; reject it and add coverage in tests/error.test.mjs.
Behaviour-change: yes
## Fix delta
<contents of /tmp/wave1-fix1.delta>
<trajectory block from code-quality-reviewer-prompt.md, verbatim>` })
```

The observed verdict is `SHIP`, which is clean. The loop ends, and no `TRAJECTORY:` line applies.

## 6. Wave commit and tracker (only now)

The gate is satisfied: SR passed, scoped tests passed, and CR returned `SHIP`.

```bash
git -C "$W" rev-parse HEAD     # still $B
git -C "$W" add -- src/parse.mjs tests/parse.test.mjs tests/error.test.mjs
git -C "$W" commit -m "Wave 1: Task 1 number parsing (reject empty string)"
git -C "$W" status --short     # clean
```

Then mark the task complete:

```ts
plan_tracker({ action: "update", index: <Task 1 index>, status: "complete" })
```

This is the stopping boundary.

github-copilot/gpt-6.1-sol.text:
Below, `${TASK_1}`, `${TEST_CONTRACT}`, and `${SPEC_ANCHORS}` mean the available full task text, verbatim Tests contract (including Test paths), and exact Spec anchors—not summaries. Shell variables persist between steps.

### 1. Initial wave code review

The patch is already integrated and staged. Keep the wave uncommitted:

```bash
cd /workspace/project
WAVE_BASE_SHA=1111111111111111111111111111111111111111
INITIAL_REVIEW_HEAD=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
INITIAL_CR_TREE=$(git write-tree)
REPORT_DIR=$(mktemp -d)

git diff --stat "$WAVE_BASE_SHA" -- .
git diff --binary "$WAVE_BASE_SHA" -- .
```

Dispatch:

```js
subagent({
  agent: "code-reviewer",
  async: false,
  cwd: "/workspace/project",
  task: `Use the supplied code-reviewer template.
DESCRIPTION: Task 1's integrated implementation.
PLAN_OR_REQUIREMENTS:
${TASK_1}
${TEST_CONTRACT}
Spec: /workspace/project/doc/specs/numbers.md:8-10
BASE_SHA: 1111111111111111111111111111111111111111
HEAD_SHA: WORKTREE
SCOPED_TEST_COMMANDS: node --test tests/parse.test.mjs

Review staged and unstaged changes against Base for production readiness.
Read touched files in full. Do not edit files.`
})
```

The supplied `FIX_FIRST` report triggers fix 1; `Behaviour-change: yes` requires SR before CR after repair.

### 2. Repair dispatch

```js
subagent({
  agent: "implementer",
  async: false,
  cwd: "/workspace/project",
  task: `Repair Task 1 in place.
${TASK_1}
${TEST_CONTRACT}
${SPEC_ANCHORS}
Authoritative spec: /workspace/project/doc/specs/numbers.md:8-10

SCOPED_TEST_COMMANDS: node --test tests/parse.test.mjs
Run only that verification command. Add the requested regression coverage.
The initial wave deliverables are staged. Leave your repair UNCOMMITTED
and UNSTAGED; the orchestrator owns the wave commit. Do not reset HEAD.
Implement the fix, self-review, and return an explicit status:
DONE, DONE_WITH_CONCERNS, NEEDS_CONTEXT, or BLOCKED.
Report changed files, verification results and test-contract compliance.

Triggering review report, verbatim:
Verdict: FIX_FIRST
Moderate: src/parse.mjs accepts an empty string as zero; reject it and add coverage in tests/error.test.mjs.
Behaviour-change: yes`
})
```

### 3. Recover the unexpected commit and capture only the repair

The supplied worker observation is `DONE`, committed at `2222222222222222222222222222222222222222`. This violates the uncommitted-wave instruction; do not use `HEAD..HEAD` or treat an empty ordinary working-tree diff as “no repair.”

Capture the resulting tree, fold HEAD back to the wave base while retaining content, then restore the initial-review index to expose the repair as an unstaged delta:

```bash
cd /workspace/project
REPAIR_COMMIT=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
# Expected observation: 2222222222222222222222222222222222222222
git status --short
git add -- src/parse.mjs tests/parse.test.mjs tests/error.test.mjs
REPAIRED_TREE=$(git write-tree)

git reset --soft "$INITIAL_REVIEW_HEAD"
git read-tree "$INITIAL_CR_TREE"
git add -N -- tests/error.test.mjs

git diff --binary > "$REPORT_DIR/fix-1.patch"
git diff --stat
git add -- src/parse.mjs tests/parse.test.mjs tests/error.test.mjs
node --test tests/parse.test.mjs
```

These operations preserve the repaired working-tree content. The repair delta is the captured in-place patch, not a commit-range diff. The supplied rerun passes; neither that observation nor this command establishes that `tests/error.test.mjs` was executed.

### 4. Behaviour-change SR first

Dispatch against the **current implementation checkout**, not a pre-integration snapshot:

```js
subagent({
  agent: "spec-reviewer",
  async: false,
  cwd: "/workspace/project",
  task: `First review of the behaviour-changing repair to Task 1.
${TASK_1}
${TEST_CONTRACT}
${SPEC_ANCHORS}
Read /workspace/project/doc/specs/numbers.md:8-10.
Review the repair patch at ${REPORT_DIR}/fix-1.patch against those requirements.
Start from its diff hunks; read every touched file in full.
Never execute tests. Report spec compliance.`
})
```

This is SR review 2, continuing the initial SR count, but has **no previous-review marker** and no trajectory requirement. Proceed only after the supplied `COMPLIANT` observation.

### 5. CR re-review

```js
subagent({
  agent: "code-reviewer",
  async: false,
  cwd: "/workspace/project",
  task: `Use the supplied code-reviewer template.
DESCRIPTION: Task 1 after repair.
PLAN_OR_REQUIREMENTS:
${TASK_1}
${TEST_CONTRACT}
Spec: /workspace/project/doc/specs/numbers.md:8-10
BASE_SHA: 1111111111111111111111111111111111111111
HEAD_SHA: WORKTREE
SCOPED_TEST_COMMANDS: node --test tests/parse.test.mjs

## Fix delta
${FULL_VERBATIM_CONTENTS_OF_FIX_1_PATCH}

## Previous review report (re-review trigger)
Verdict: FIX_FIRST
Moderate: src/parse.mjs accepts an empty string as zero; reject it and add coverage in tests/error.test.mjs.
Behaviour-change: yes

If issues remain, append exactly one TRAJECTORY line after Behaviour-change:
TRAJECTORY: CONVERGING (<n_prev> -> <n_now>, max severity <X>)
TRAJECTORY: DIVERGING
TRAJECTORY: STAGNANT (repeat of: <finding>)
Choose STAGNANT first if a prior Critical/Moderate survives materially
unchanged; otherwise DIVERGING if the count does not fall or a new
Critical/Moderate appears; otherwise CONVERGING. Count only
Critical/Moderate findings; X is Critical, Moderate, or Minor.
If clean, omit TRAJECTORY.`
})
```

### 6. Commit only after the supplied `SHIP`

```bash
cd /workspace/project
git add -- src/parse.mjs tests/parse.test.mjs tests/error.test.mjs
git commit -m "Implement Task 1 number parsing and regression coverage"
git status --short
```

Then:

```js
plan_tracker({ action: "update", index: 1, status: "complete" })
```

An empty delta **before recovery** can merely mean the worker committed everything. An empty delta **after comparison with the initial-review tree** means no net repair was captured; investigate rather than claiming the finding was fixed or progressing. Stop here.
